qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:13,19 (flow grouping; 'A negative needs a successful control')
qc/runs/kittle-2026-10-09-r7/raw-evidence-index.json (golden-only scripted observations; no weak-app discrimination runs on these bytes)
evidence: Most negative legs are well controlled inside the same criterion: signin_and_client_scope (functional/judge.toml:47-51) records Gwen's working list/thread/mentions/search/transcript requests and a working M-11 post before signed-out/cross-client replays; wall_every_route uses Sian's thread/search/transcript and Dev's own M-11 reply as controls (:61-67); wall_added_live, deleted_and_expired (incl. the one-second-younger message, :127), timer_changes (:138,:143, 'executor' still found), hold_scope_and_release (legs 1,2,6), edits_and_stale_edit (first edit saves; JUDGE-ME2 shows before delete), message_links (P1 preview), unread (count must be 2), sent_once (D2), search Part A/C, persistence step c, delete_confirm (confirm deletes), refusal_in_place (right password works) and render gate (Gwen signs in) all pair refusal/absence with a success. Two legs lack a matching success case: (1) polish transcript_print (polish/judge.toml:61-63) is purely an absence-of-overflow check, 'documentElement.scrollWidth equals the viewport width and every message's text can be read', with no requirement that the M-11 transcript actually lists messages; 'every message' is vacuous on an empty or not-available page, and the golden itself renders a 'No messages.' or not-available page that is narrow (server.js:497-517). (2) wall_every_route leg 2 (functional/judge.toml:63) credits Dev's search returning nothing, but the only search control is Sian's (a different user); no leg shows Dev's search still finds something he may see, and no other criterion runs a positive search as Dev. No weak-app runs exist on these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope), so neither gap is measured.
counterexample: (1) An app whose /transcripts/M-11 renders only a heading, an empty list, or a 'not available' page for Gwen (broken transcript or authorization) has scrollWidth == 390 and no message text to overflow, so transcript_print can pass by absence of evidence. (2) An app that returns an empty result set for any search by a user who has any wall (over-blocking or a crashing wall join) passes wall_every_route leg 2 even though Dev's search is dead for M-11/M-13, and no criterion catches it.
suggested_fix: (1) In transcript_print add a positive control: the transcript shows M-11's heading and messages such as 'Survey booked for Friday.' with author and time before checking scrollWidth; fail if no messages are listed. (2) In wall_every_route leg 2 add: as Dev, searching 'Survey booked' finds the M-11 message (positive control), so 'nothing from M-12' is only credited when Dev's search works.
